verdict: A two-day delivery halt cut lead flow; Google Ads remains unproductive.
narrative: This period you received 117 leads through Meta at a cost of $16.85 per lead, but the last seven days were significantly disrupted: both ad channels went dark on September 17–18, producing zero leads on those two days and driving a 57.89% drop in weekly lead volume. That stoppage also pushed cost per lead up 38.3% week-over-week. Separately, Google Ads spent $467 over the full 28 days and returned no conversions — that budget is being reviewed and will be redirected toward what is working. Delivery is being restored and the coming week should reflect a return to normal daily lead flow as campaigns are back active.

cost per lead over the last 28 days

watch_item.fix: The campaign is under active review and spend is being evaluated for reallocation to Meta, where all leads this period originated.
